name: Alberta

standard.note: Alberta's long-running everyday plate is white with red characters and the slogan "Wild Rose Country"; a new "Strong and Free" plate with a Moraine Lake panorama, picked by public vote in November 2025, was due to start issuing in mid-2026.

plates.title: Alberta Conservation Plate
plates.fact: The design shows Mount Lougheed and Rocky Mountain bighorn sheep, Alberta's official provincial mammal.

plates.title: Edmonton Oilers Licence Plate
plates.fact: Proceeds help fund health, wellness, education and minor hockey programs for youth in northern Alberta.

plates.title: Calgary Flames Licence Plate
plates.fact: The plate features the Flames' colours, logo and slogan.

plates.title: Support our Troops Licence Plate
plates.supports: Support our Troops program (Canadian Forces Morale and Welfare Services)
plates.fact: Its artwork honours the first four Alberta-based Canadian soldiers killed in Afghanistan in April 2002, and anyone can order it.

plates.title: Veterans licence plate
plates.fact: Applicants must be approved by the Royal Canadian Legion, Alberta/NWT Command.

plates.title: Amateur Radio Operator (HAM) licence plate
plates.fact: Available to Albertans who hold an Amateur Radio Operator Certificate.

notes: eservices.alberta.ca images are the province's own plate artwork, ~2:1, no query strings (sizes checked in browser: Oilers 1800x901, Flames 1800x900, Troops 1680x843, Conservation 912x477). alberta.ca would not stay loaded in the browser (navigation kept reverting), so the main licence-plates page was read only via WebFetch; it also has card images with itok tokens (e.g. https://www.alberta.ca/system/files/styles/card_image_regular/private/custom_downloaded_images/licence-plate-calgary-flames2.jpg?itok=cP4_vAal) as a fallback. No official image found for the standard plate (old Wild Rose Country or new Strong and Free/Moraine Lake) or for the veterans plate (Legion AB/NWT site failed to load). Oilers/Flames year 2018 is from news coverage of their launch, not the registry page. HAM plate may be a call-sign-only plate with no special design; drop it if so. Personalized and antique plates excluded per brief.
